title: feat(spec): a field group's requiresFeature hides the group where a deployment feature is off; Edit organization hides Parent Organization and Sort Order on one organization
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKdMdBgsLj6ZtbKmEBFgfcw)_

Fixes #30692

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #30812 — skills/objectstack-data/references/examples-objects.md (its Field Groups section teaches `fieldGroups` and should name `visibleWhen` and `requiresFeature` beside `collapse`); kept out of this diff so it does not become a governed `skills/**` change

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：字段分组新增 `requiresFeature`（与动作上的同名键同一套特性名），解析时降成该分组的 `visibleWhen` 并从输出中去掉；组织对象声明了四个字段分组，「上级组织」「排序」所在的「集团结构」组要求 `multiOrgEnabled`。
- 为什么改：单组织部署的「编辑组织」页一直显示这两个毫无作用的字段（裁定 6670372892，#30210 第 4 行 A）。现在只有多组织部署才看得到。
- 风险与回滚：表单和详情页现在按分组显示（标题：基本信息 / 品牌 / 配置 / 集团结构），字段顺序不变；隐藏只是界面层，API 照常读写这两个字段。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`（新键与降级 transform）；`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` 的 `withoutLoweredFeatureGate`（lint 只放行降级出来的那一个门）；`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization.object.ts`（四个分组）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects exec vitest run src/identity/sys-organization-group-structure-gate.test.ts`，预期 4 条全绿：`multiOrgEnabled` 关时两字段不出现，开时出现。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/spec`: `fieldGroups[].requiresFeature`.** The field-group twin of the action-level `requiresFeature`, from the same `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` vocabulary, so an unknown flag is refused at parse (`invalid_value` at `requiresFeature`). It is lowered at parse into the group's `visibleWhen` by the same helper the action key uses, `lowerRequiresFeature`, which now takes an optional third argument naming the slot (`'visible'` by default, `'visibleWhen'` here); its refusals name that slot. The slot is a type parameter and the input's constraint is keyed on it, so lowering an action into `'visibleWhen'`, or a field group into the default `'visible'`, fails to compile; the action call sites are unchanged. The key is stripped from the output.
  - **How the two combine** when an author writes both: AND, the author's predicate first and the gate last, exactly as for actions: `visibleWhen: "record.kind == 'child'"` + `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'` parses to `(record.kind == 'child') && features.multiOrgEnabled != false`. A non-CEL `visibleWhen` refuses the pair, as for actions.
  - `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES.multiOrgEnabled.gatedInputs` books `sys_organization.fieldGroups.group_structure`; the `gatedInputs` path grammar admits `OBJECT.fieldGroups.KEY`, and the platform-objects completeness guard walks field groups in both directions.
  - `object.form.ts` offers the key on the `fieldGroups` repeater (label and help in en / zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES). Liveness: `object/fieldGroups.requiresFeature` is `live`.
- **`@objectstack/lint`: the lowered gate is accepted.** The field-group `visibleWhen` root verdict now judges the predicate with the trailing gate a `requiresFeature` lowers to taken off (`withoutLoweredFeatureGate`): the gate alone, or `(AUTHORED) && GATE` where the authored part parses on its own. Any other `features` read in a group predicate keeps its root verdict, and its message now points at `requiresFeature`. The finding still quotes the whole predicate.
- **`@objectstack/platform-objects`: `sys_organization` declares `fieldGroups`.** Identity, Branding, Configuration, Group Structure, in the fields' own order, so no field moves; `id` / `created_at` / `updated_at` keep `group: 'System'`, which is not declared, so they render last in the ungrouped bucket as before. Group Structure (`parent_organization_id`, `sort_order`) carries `requiresFeature: 'multiOrgEnabled'`. Section labels are translated in zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES.

The ui is unchanged, as the ruling says: the form's section gate and the record page's `record:details` (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` `sectionPredicateVisible`) both evaluate a group's `visibleWhen` with `usePredicateScope()`, which carries the host's `features`.

## Tests

- Reproduced on `main` (`1371b9d8`, the object before this PR, tests from this PR): `sys-organization-group-structure-gate.test.ts` 3 failed / 1 passed; with `multiOrgEnabled: false` the flat layout still renders `parent_organization_id`.
- New pins: `packages/spec/src/data/field-group-requires-feature.test.ts` (lowered and stripped; an opt-in flag gets its own gate; unknown flag refused at `requiresFeature`; both-present AND-composition from a string and from an envelope; unchanged without the key; inside `ObjectSchema.create`; and two `@ts-expect-error` compile pins: an action lowered into `'visibleWhen'` and a field group lowered into the default slot), `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-organization-group-structure-gate.test.ts` (off hides, on shows, empty `features` faults and hides, only that group gated, declaration order kept), and a `#30692` describe in the lint harness `runtime-gate.object-field-group-visibility-writes.test.ts` (three lowered shapes publish clean at the door and the build; the unlowered key is clean; five hand-written `features` shapes keep the verdict; the prescription names `requiresFeature`).
- Full suites on the pre-merge head `ab3d3a94`: `@objectstack/spec` 818/818 files, 25833 tests; `@objectstack/lint` 195/195, 8226; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 117/117, 1585; the three typechecks exit 0; `check:generated` exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour)</summary>

- Spec lowering, through `dist/`: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the transform with one that keeps the group and plants `ABLATION_30692` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `47ddc173` → `c0bfefc3`); spec rebuilt; `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` found the marker in 10 built files. Red: spec pin 4 failed / 2 passed; platform-objects 4 failed (the three group-structure cells and the guard's forward row `sys_organization.fieldGroups.group_structure is gated on multiOrgEnabled`). Restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty; spec rebuilt; preflight `--absent` clean over 592 files and the tree; the same two files green, 118/118.
- Lint peel (source-imported, no dist leg): the verdict call fed `raw` instead of `withoutLoweredFeatureGate(raw)` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `7b9a6ec1` → `85289f1e`). Red: the three lowered-shape CONTROL cells; restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The `features` root is not opened on group predicates generally (ruling row 4 B was not chosen): only the exact trailing gate the lowering emits is accepted. A hand-written predicate byte-identical to that lowered form is accepted too, because it is the same gate.
- **Fault direction.** A group's `visibleWhen` is fail-closed, where an action's `visible` is fail-soft. Reading a key that `features` does not carry is a CEL fault (`No such key`), not `null`, so with `features = {}` the default-on gate faults and the group is hidden. The console holds `features = {}` until `/auth/config` resolves (`AppContent.tsx`), and keeps it if that fetch fails. So on a multi-organization deployment Group Structure is hidden for the pre-fetch window and appears when the config arrives; if the fetch fails it stays hidden for that session. `getPublicConfig()` in plugin-auth always publishes `multiOrgEnabled`. A host that never publishes `features` would hide the group everywhere. The semantics table in `public-auth-features.ts`, the field-group docblock and the changeset say so, and `sys-organization-group-structure-gate.test.ts` pins the empty-scope reading.
- Row 4 C's help text ("Meaningful only where the deployment runs several organizations.") stays, and stays reachable: the fields still show wherever `multiOrgEnabled` is on.
- Declaring the groups adds section headers to sys_organization's form and record page; the field order is unchanged.
- `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` keep their undeclared `group: 'System'` (the `field-group-undeclared` advisory fires for those three, where before it fired for all twelve fields); declaring a System group would surface `created_at` / `updated_at` on the record page, a change the card did not ask for.

## Verification

Head `559cf504` (review follow-up on `24375ec4`; merges cleanly with `origin/main` `2038c56e`), with spec and platform-objects rebuilt:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 105 families on `559cf504`; all 105 exit 0, each code captured to a file before any pipe. `--ran`: 105 derived, 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Its STALE TREE note names only `scripts/pm/**` fleet tooling that moved on main, none on this diff's surface.
- `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:cli-command-ids`, `pnpm check:adr-symbol-anchors`, `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: exit 0. `packages/spec` `check:generated` (incl. api-surface and test-typecheck): exit 0.
- Suites (`vitest run` in each package): `@objectstack/spec` 908/908 files, 27374 passed + 1 todo; `@objectstack/lint` 195/195, 8235; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 117/117, 1590.
- Ablation of the slot key: the other-slot exclusion in `WithRequiresFeature` replaced with an inert key; `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` then reports both `@ts-expect-error` pins as unused (TS2578); restored from the saved copy, marker count 0.
- Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).
- Open PRs on the surface: #30760 edits `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/{en,es-ES,ja-JP,zh-CN}.ts`; this PR touches the `*.objects.generated.ts` and `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles beside them, not those files.
